description: Open + in_progress rightsizing recs (identified monthly savings). Hidden is parked and not in identified. Never add identified to captured. Source is logs-finops.rightsizing-*.

configuration.query:
FROM logs-finops.rightsizing-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 90 days
    AND finops.rightsizing.status IN ("open", "in_progress")
| STATS recs = COUNT_DISTINCT(finops.rightsizing.id),
        identified_usd = SUM(finops.rightsizing.estimated_monthly_savings)
    BY finops.rightsizing.resource_name, finops.rightsizing.action,
       finops.rightsizing.current_type, finops.rightsizing.recommended_type,
       finops.rightsizing.resource_arn, cloud.account.id
| SORT identified_usd DESC
